backend/main.mo: Motoko actor handling media uploads, user profiles, access control, and live session metadata using blob storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of all major frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variables defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routing, splash screen timing, theme provider, and navigation across all pages.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering the navbar, main page container, and footer around routed content.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty-state UI component showing an icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: App footer with branding, quick links, Discord community info, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with links, authentication state, and user profile display.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for entering and saving a user's display name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Displays a vertical short-video preview card with thumbnail, title, and duration.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Fullscreen splash screen showing a branded background image during app load.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Form for uploading videos or shorts, handling metadata extraction, progress, and submission.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays a standard video preview card with thumbnail, duration, date, and title.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Custom video player with play controls, seeking, volume, fullscreen, and exposed pause API.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: Timer UI that counts down and triggers a callback to stop playback when it ends.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, user profiles, uploads, and live session data via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables and utility styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays a grid of videos, handles loading states, and prompts logged‑in users to set up their profiles.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Shows details for a specific live session, including owner controls to end the session and error/loading handling.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Lists active live sessions and lets authenticated users start new metadata‑only live sessions.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Displays a grid of short videos with loading and empty‑state handling.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Handles media uploads, requiring authentication and optional profile setup before submitting content.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Renders the video watch page, loading media by title, showing the video player, metadata, and a viewer timer that can pause playback.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and enabled plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks the OmniStream project state, listing implemented features, requirements, and architectural notes.
